latestVersion.changelog:
Universal-autostart v1.0.0

- Initial release of a cross-platform auto-start service manager for Windows and macOS.
- Supports installing, uninstalling, starting, stopping, and monitoring background services.
- Enables automatic restart of services on failure.
- Provides persistent service setup that survives system reboots using sc/schtasks (Windows) or launchd (macOS).
